bio: Chris Muscat is a photographer based in Melbourne. His practice moves between editorial work and long personal projects — united by an interest in quiet light, honest rooms and the pause before a subject settles.

Trained first as an architect, he photographs buildings the way he photographs people: waiting for the moment structure becomes atmosphere. His work has appeared in international publications and exhibitions, and he lectures occasionally on photographic process.
His photographs are available for licensing in editorial and media use — get in touch for usage enquiries.
